name: Hezekiah
overview: Hezekiah is recognized in Scripture as a significant figure associated with the restoration and protection of Jerusalem, as evidenced by references to his lineage among the children of Ater (Ezra 2:16; Nehemiah 7:21) and the mention of his name in the context of the city's rebuilding efforts (Nehemiah 10:17). The detailed descriptions of the city's gates and walls being repaired and fortified (Nehemiah 2:13; 3:13, 3:16) reflect the broader historical and spiritual renewal connected to his reign and legacy. These passages highlight Hezekiah's role in the preservation and strengthening of God's people and their worship in Jerusalem.
